gaps.sentence: Much to everyone’s ___ (APPOINT), the open-air concert was cancelled.
gaps.explanation: 'To somebody’s disappointment' — the feeling noun follows the possessive.

gaps.sentence: You will need written ___ (PERMIT) to enter the site.
gaps.explanation: 'Written permission' — the noun you can be given in writing.

gaps.sentence: He spoke ___ (CONFIDENT) in front of the camera.
We owe our success to her ___ (VISION) leadership.
The journal gave full ___ (COVER) to the election.
gaps.explanation: 'Media coverage' — the noun for how much something is reported.
'Arrived damaged' — participle describing the state of the parcel.

gaps.sentence: The mountain road has been ___ (WIDE) to cope with coach traffic.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'has been widened' — the verb form meaning made wider.
'A brief introduction' — the noun from introduce.
